Fett Authlete RFC 9700 Best Current Practice for OAuth 2. 0 Security Abstract This document describes best current security practice for OAuth 2. It updates and extends the threat model and security advice given in RFCs 6749, 6750, and 6819 to incorporate practical experiences gathered since OAuth 2. 0 was published and covers new threats relevant due to the broader application of OAuth 2.
